build: Debug APK, version 0.1.0, Capacitor 8.6.0, Android API 36
device: Android Emulator, API 36, 1080x2400 physical / 411x914 dp, 420 dpi

tests.notes: Three sample projects loaded. No backend/network is required for the local UI.

tests.scenario: Export JSON backup through Android Storage Access Framework
tests.artifact: folio-backup (1).json in emulator Downloads; parsed as JSON: title correct, 3 projects, 4803 bytes.

tests.notes: Cancellation is reported; app remains available and data is unchanged.
Android loggingBehavior=none; source plugin debug logs removed. No native call payload was observed in logcat after a save run.
Import preview lists 3 existing ID matches. Full replace asks to save folio-before-import.json first. Back/cancel returns to preview and no replacement occurs.
Adaptive launcher icon uses the folio vector mark, app label is folio, Android splash uses matching lime/ink brand colors, first screen loads.

tests.scenario: CSV export through Android Storage Access Framework
tests.notes: Saved while the emulator had no active default network. Parsed as UTF-8 BOM, semicolon-delimited CSV: 3 expected project records, 20 columns.

tests.scenario: Cold launch with Wi-Fi and mobile data disabled
tests.notes: Android dumpsys connectivity reported Active default network: none. App opened to dashboard with demo records and offline status; local UI remained available.

tests.scenario: Cold start splash retention and transition after local data is ready
tests.notes: After moving setKeepOnScreenCondition before BridgeActivity super.onCreate, launcher splash was visible in screenshots at 150 ms, 500 ms and 1 second. By 4 seconds the dashboard had replaced it. Active default network was none during the run; the 15-second fallback was not reached.

limitations: Tested on Android Emulator API 36 only; physical Android device and OEM file picker remain to be checked.
APK is a debug-signed test build, not a release/store build.
Desktop-to-phone synchronization is still manual JSON export/import; no cloud sync is implemented.
